epg.title: Teri Maang Sitaron Se Bhar Doon
epg.description: Kamini undergoes several hardships in her life for her daughter. However, things take a turn when a gangster decides to help her.

epg.title: Ittefaq
epg.description: A police officer investigates a double murder with two witnesses who are suspects: Vikram, a writer, and Maya, a homemaker-whose accounts clash that night.

epg.title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
epg.description: A doctor has no faith in the powers of Sai Baba. However, his wife and he travel to Shirdi when their son falls sick. After hearing certain stories of Sai Baba, the doctor develops faith in him.

epg.title: Pyaasa Sawan
epg.description: Prabhudas mistakenly thinks that he is son of a wealthy man and wants him to marry his daughter. They marry but go through a lot of troubles.

epg.title: Gentleman
epg.description: Kicha impersonates a gentleman to win Susheela's affection, but his deception leads to hilarious misunderstandings and emotional complications.

epg.title: Bawarchi
epg.description: Desperate for a cook, the disgruntled Sharmas are relieved when a multi-talented man, Raghu, takes up the job. However, when all seems well, the family jewels disappear and so does Raghu.

epg.title: Upkar
epg.description: Bharat sacrifices everything to educate his brother Puran. However, Puran turns into a greedy man and gets involved in drug trafficking in order to make money.

epg.title: Shehzada
epg.description: Bantu, despised by his father Valmiki, discovers his true parents, the Jindals, and strives to win their affection while protecting them from threats.

epg.title: Abhinetri
epg.description: Shekhar, a young scientist, falls in love with Anjana, a dancer, and marries her. Differences separate the couple but when Shekhar's mother visits, they are forced to unite again.

epg.title: Parivar (1968)
epg.description: Gopal, a medical student, marries Meena and starts a family. Their peaceful life is disrupted by tragedy as their daughter dies and Gopal is accused of murder.

epg.title: Neela Akash
